messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting an admin entitlement sweep next week. Goal: remove stale org-level admins. Asking owners to confirm justifications by EOW.
kevin: thanks. what's the scope? org + billing?
maria: org + AWS KMS admins + service accounts with broad roles. We'll run privileged role sampling and ownerless role detector.
jamal: can we get a list of candidates? would like to feed to compliance for evidence.
access-bot: scan complete. 42 candidate admins flagged: 12 ownerless, 18 with >90 days inactive, 12 temp-elevations still present.
iris: pinging eng leads to review owners for the 12 ownerless ones. Can we automate removal if no owner in 7 days?
kevin: prefer 1-week email + 48h grace before auto-snap, but need manual approval for roles with KMS/admin scope.
maria: agreed. auto-removal applies only to non-KMS roles. For KMS admin we need ticket + KMS audit log link.
olga: question — KMS keys with cross-account bindings show up in this scan, right? we should avoid breaking any cross-account ingestions.
jamal: yes, scan marks cross-account keys; we'll add a 'do-not-prune' tag if service-owner verifies.
maria: action items: 1) jamal export CSV of flagged accounts + evidence link 2) iris send owner review emails 3) kevin run canary revoke on 3 non-critical accounts Wed
maria: timeline: start Monday, finalize removals next Friday. escalate blockers to @security-oncall
kevin: noted. also add a metric: reduction in org-admins and KMS admin counts weekly.
iris: adding runbook snippet:
```
1. run `scripts/priv-scan --since 90d --roles admin` 
2. review CSV
3. tag do-not-prune or submit removal PR
4. if KMS, attach KMS audit URL and ticket
```
jamal: will send CSV by EOD Fri
maria: thanks all. if no objections, I'll post a short announcement to #all-hands template for change window
kevin: :thumbsup:
access-bot: reminder scheduled: owner review emails will go out Mon 09:00 PST
